messages:
carmen_sales: Helix POC request: 15 users, 2 weeks. They want daily rotation and IP-restricted hosted keys. Can we support self-service rotation or do we manage it?

rekha_se: We support both. Default: we manage rotation (to avoid secret leaks). If they need self-rotation, we can issue a scoped rotator token limited to /keys/rotate and bound to their org.

ben_devops: Rotation flow we recommend:
1) Create replacement key with same scopes
2) Deliver secret via secure share link
3) Revoke old key
4) Confirm no traffic on old key
Example rotate call (customer rotator token):
```
POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/rotate
Auth: Bearer <rotator-token>
Body: {"key_id":"k_helix_001","ttl_seconds":86400}
```
Response: new secret (one-time).

carmen_sales: Security will want IP allowlist, tagging, and audit forwarding. Also spend caps per token.

tom_security: Requirements: IP allowlist required, tags: `purpose:poc`, `owner:carmen`, `customer:helix`. If PII involved set TTL<=72h and enable S3 export of audit logs. All rotate/revoke events must emit `key.rotated` and `key.revoked` to SIEM.

rekha_se: We'll provision two token classes: `poc-standard` TTL=7d and `poc-sensitive` TTL=3d. Per-token spend cap default $200 for 2 weeks. Alerts at 50/80/95% to carmen + billing.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Provisioned keys k_helix_01..k_helix_15 (pending CIDR). Runbook added: https://redwood.internal/t/SF-5710.

carmen_sales: Perfect. I'll collect CIDRs and confirm PII. If they insist on self-rotation, I'll request the rotator callback URL and confirm SAML/SSO admin. Thanks! :thumbsup:
